description: Retrieval questions over samples/. Each question lists one or more passages that answer it; a retrieved chunk is relevant when it comes from that document and contains the passage text (whitespace-insensitive). 'exact' questions hinge on an identifier, code or acronym; 'paraphrase' questions are worded differently from the documents.
